meta.title: Video Head Swap
meta.summary: Animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video.

hero.title: Video Head Swap
hero.summary: Animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video.

endpoint_summary.summary: Animate a swapped face image with a driving video to produce a head swap video.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Upload the source file and create a file reference before calling this endpoint.
Successful requests return a Medux task record immediately. Use the task query or sync endpoints to track completion.
All file inputs must be uploaded and persisted as file references before submission.

fields.name: face_image_file_id
fields.description: Face reference image file_id used for the head swap target.

fields.name: positive_prompt
fields.description: Positive prompt text for the animation workflow. Default: 一个角色在说话.

fields.name: edit_prompt
fields.description: Edit instruction for preserving the swapped face identity. Default: 人脸保持不变.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Animate head swap model id. Default: animate-head-swap-default.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Application response code.

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | OK |
| `12` | Invalid input |
| `1401` | Insufficient credits |
| `1404` | Provider returned an error |
| `1405` | Provider request timed out |
| `13` | Authentication is required |
| `16` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `99` | Server error |

examples.title: Examples
examples.request_example:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/process/video/animate_head_swap \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"edit_prompt":"人脸保持不变","face_image_file_id":"FILE_ID","height":832,"input_video_file_id":"FILE_ID","model_id":"animate-head-swap-default","positive_prompt":"一个角色在说话","width":480}'
examples.curl_command:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/process/video/animate_head_swap \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
